name: Nature Domain
summary: Clerics of the wild who command beasts and plants.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.short: Learn a druid cantrip and a nature skill.
features.summary: You learn one druid cantrip and gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature or Survival.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.summary: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
features.short: Charm beasts and plants within 30 ft.
features.summary: As an action, each beast or plant creature that can see you within 30 ft. makes a WIS save or is charmed by you for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

features.name: Dampen Elements
features.short: Reaction: give resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage.
features.summary: When you or a creature within 30 ft. takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to grant resistance against that instance.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.short: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 cold, fire or lightning (your choice) (2d8 at 14th).
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 cold, fire or lightning (your choice) damage. At 14th level the extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Master of Nature
features.short: Command charmed beasts and plants as a bonus action.
features.summary: While creatures are charmed by your Charm Animals and Plants, you can take a bonus action to verbally command what each will do on its next turn.
